body: U+0023# 2026-10-03: remaining cleanup and spec wording finished; criterion movedU+000AU+000AU+002D PR #247 merged on 2026-10-01. Its cleanup is done: the worktree `~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/work/manual` and every run directory under `~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/` (including the `2026-09-30-recolour*` runs) were moved to `~/.Trash/field-notes-cleanup-2026-10-03/`, not deleted. The worktrees `recolour-247`, `pacer` and `pacing-probe`, the branches `mitosis/meadow-recolour-{amend,pacer,fixes}` and old apps under `testkit/apps` were already gone.U+000AU+002D The Meadow spec's load-time wording now follows the owner's decision: in `docs/specs/meadow.md`, 16.19 is titled "The scene appears without a long frame"; 16.22 keeps "no frame over 100 ms", bounds scene-ready at 1 second on the Mac only, and reports it unbounded on older devices such as the Note10+; the page table row says the same.U+000AU+002D Criterion 3 (366 flowers at 60 fps) moved word for word to thread meadow-sweep (decision 01M42HJSPQDCY11HDQG62F56PJ), where the 2026-10-03 device check measured it.
